findings.observation: The right shore-intake discharge visibly joins the right cooked OUT route and customer branch. Raw whole fish and cooked output share the same junction. This contradicts the required raw-input / cooked-output topology.

Both rear storage lines approach the left cooker IN neck. The lower OUT line visibly carries prepared-food trays into a raw-fish feed. There is no distinct storage dispatch path to an exclusive fresh/store merge.
The timber counter remains freestanding inside the camp, with its long customer face toward the interior and a continuous east fence behind it. Outside customers cannot reach its serving face.
The west house utility dock is crowded against the fence. A continuous usable route from the gate corridor around the left utility equipment to the rear service strip is not visibly established.

Customer buffer has a green beacon while the striped stop bar spans the carrier path. Choose a coherent state: raised/ready or amber closed/full. The dedicated counter sheet already demonstrates both.

required_repairs: Rotate the whole canonical cooker 180 degrees, preserving physical handedness: east raw IN from intake, west cooked OUT to diverter, front controls toward a clear northern service strip. Do not merely exchange labels on unchanged plumbing.

From the cooked output, show one-in/two-out diverter with separate surplus-to-storage-IN and fresh-to-counter branches. Route storage OUT independently into the second input of the gated counter merge, never the cooker.

Rotate the customer table north-south into a deliberate east fence serving opening. Keep register/keypad and staff approach inside/west, customer face outside/east, and a separate finite pickup buffer at the stock end.
Widen or recompose the rear/west storage margin so a continuous route from the gate corridor reaches the utility service face and rear sleeves without crossing belts.
Make the visible stop bar/beacon/item state coherent; retain the terminal pickup guard and separate manual tabletop handoff.
approval_boundary: Actual physical topology fails. A disclaimer that this is conceptual cannot substitute for rerendering the visibly wrong connections. Keep r2 and its failed review; camp r1 was a tool-schema failure with no image and has no visual score.
